sb.name: Angel
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The angel's weapon attacks are magical. When the angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The angel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: The angel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel's choice). In a new form, the angel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

sb.name: Archon of Redemption
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: One Being
traits.desc: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Destructive Wave|destructive wave]], [[Tools/Spells/Geas|geas]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

traits.name: Trampling Charge

If the target is prone, the baloth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the crawler can bite only the grappled creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The crawler spits acid in a line that is 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, provided that it has no creature grappled. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Sight

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The drake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.

sb.name: Emrakul
sb.damage_immunities: fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks; psychic

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Emrakul fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Emrakul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.desc: Any time Emrakul is targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]] spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, Emrakul is unaffected. On a 6, Emrakul is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from Emrakul, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Emrakul deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Emrakul can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Emrakul can't bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Emrakul's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Emrakul is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Emrakul's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: Emrakul makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Emrakul, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of Emrakul's turns. If Emrakul takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Emrakul must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Emrakul. If Emrakul dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Emrakul makes one claw attack or tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Emrakul moves up to half its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Emrakul makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

actions.name: Fling

If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.desc: Kozilek magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target Kozilek can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling

legendary_actions.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kozilek uses Lightning Storm.

Each creature other than Kozilek that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of Kozilek's next turn.

actions.desc:
The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw.

- **First Roar.** Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- **Second Roar.** Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- **Third Roar.** Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The spirit enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the spirit that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this spirit's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]] spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: One humanoid that the spirit can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the spirit; the spirit then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The spirit now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The spirit can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the spirit ends it as a bonus action, or the spirit is turned or forced out by an effect like the [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell. When the possession ends, the spirit reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this spirit's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.
